collection.title: Celestial Paintings
collection.descriptionHtml:
Star maps and celestial charts, printed when you order them. Unframed paintings on matte fine-art paper. No copy is kept on a shelf.

Each sheet is one subject from a named plate. These are not a custom night sky for a date or a city.

products_in_order.title: Moon Phase
products_in_order.why: Single chart any buyer can use. Original eight-phase artwork, not a generic white-on-black circle row.

products_in_order.title: Ursa Major Constellation Print
products_in_order.why: Named star map. Public-domain Sidney Hall plate, cream atlas paper rather than gold linework on navy.

products_in_order.title: Solar System Chart Print
products_in_order.why: Celestial atlas painting. Public-domain Cellarius plate, one subject, already a Printify listing.
